This topic is part of the Edexcel GCSE Food Technology specification.

Food Choice appears in the assessment, so it's worth knowing well.

The Edexcel board expects you to understand both the concepts and how to use them.

Use the activities in this adventure to build familiarity with Food Choice.

Practise vocabulary, calculations and free-text questions to lock in the learning.
